confidence_rule: identity_confidence is assigned by rule, not per-case taste: 0.95 = canonical identity confirmed by >=2 independent official documents AND a resolved stable registry id; 0.90 = one official document plus a resolved stable registry id, or >=2 independent official documents without an id; 0.80 = one official document or one registry record that names the entity and its role but no second source; 0.60 = the entity is attested only by corpus/observed strings with parentage inferred from observed naming context (explicitly flagged as inferred); 0.40 = the string is attested but the underlying legal entity could not be pinned down.

notes.validity_semantics: valid_from/valid_to delimit the period in which the entity existed IN THE ROLE named by entity_type, not necessarily the lifetime of the legal person. Example: medtronic_inc is a former_parent with valid_to 2015-01-26; the legal entity 'Medtronic, Inc.' continues to exist as a Minnesota subsidiary (FY2025 Exhibit 21). Anachronism testing uses valid_from only, as instructed.
notes.operating_unit_rule: Rule (stated once, not re-derived per string): every string of the form 'Medtronic <unit>' (e.g. 'Medtronic - MITG', 'Medtronic Cardiac Rhythm and Heart Failure', 'Medtronic BRC') is an operating unit or department of the Medtronic group, not a separate legal entity; it maps to the group parent medtronic_plc unless the string names one of the registered subsidiaries. Rationale: the FY2025 Exhibit 21 lists the group's legal entities; a few observed strings do match legal persons (Medtronic MiniMed, Inc., Medtronic Xomed, Inc., and 'Medtronic Vascular' which is the prefix of Medtronic Vascular, Inc.) and are registered as subsidiaries or as aliases of them, while the remaining 'Medtronic <unit>' strings (MITG, Cardiac Rhythm and Heart Failure, BRC, Spinal and Biologics, ...) are divisional/portfolio names used in trial sponsorship. The same rule is applied to 'GE Healthcare <place>' (site/affiliate), 'Philips Healthcare <place>' and 'Shenzhen Mindray Bio-Medical Electronics Co., Ltd.' (registered parent).
